description: src/lib.rs:4 says 'Implements the 18-method surface described in draft-ietf-jmap-calendars-26' and src/lib.rs:42 says 'all 18 JMAP Calendars methods are available'. PLAN.md (lines 78, 122, 244) and README.md (lines 7, 146) consistently say 19. Method count: 3 Calendar + 7 CalendarEvent (get, changes, set, copy, query, queryChanges, parse) + 5 CalendarEventNotification + 3 ParticipantIdentity + 1 Principal/getAvailability = 19. Audience: a contributor reading lib.rs to understand the crate's surface gets a number that disagrees with PLAN/README — bus-factor risk. Fix: change both occurrences of '18' to '19' in src/lib.rs.
title: lib.rs doc comments say '18-method surface' but the crate ships 19 methods
